## New Entries Checklist

If adding new entries:

- [ ] Followed [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Andriy-Kulak/vskills/blob/main/AGENTS.md): post data from the X API or oEmbed, no invented values, prompt copied word for word
- [ ] Entry has a unique, properly formatted `id`
- [ ] `source_url` links to the original content
- [ ] Creator is properly attributed
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] Content is publicly available

## Verification

- [ ] I have tested my changes locally
- [ ] The build passes (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Data validation passes (`npm run validate`)
